retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome studio portrait featuring a central figure in a long black gown holding a black cat, paired with elegant Art Deco-inspired typography.
triggerTerms: monochrome studio portrait with black cat
excludeWhen: colorful or busy backgrounds are required
modern sans-serif bold typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length, high-contrast black and white photograph of a woman in a sleek, fringed black dress standing against a neutral grey gradient background. She holds a black cat at shoulder level. The composition is balanced by stylized, thin-line graphic text in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical alignment of the subject creates a strong central axis
The black cat provides a dark focal point near the subject's face
Typography in the upper right balances the visual weight of the subject's extended arms
High contrast between the black garment and the light grey background
coreInvariants: Monochrome or desaturated color palette for the main image
Full-length standing pose with a vertical silhouette
Presence of a small animal held at chest or shoulder height

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length figure centered horizontally, occupying the full vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the black cat held in her hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the cat, down the long line of the dress, and then to the graphic text in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample neutral space on the left and right sides of the subject to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the subject's hair, dress, and cat
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted red for the secondary subtitle text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with very low saturation across the entire composition.

letterConstructionRules: Horizontal bars that extend into decorative flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' is a large open circle that partially encloses other letters
The 'H' features a high crossbar that connects to adjacent glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ethereal, oversized hairline decorative lettering and solid, grounded sans-serif subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric circularity of the display text
Similar structure for the subtitle text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-length black and white studio portrait of a woman with long dark hair wearing a black fringed gown, holding a black cat in her hands at shoulder level, against a light grey gradient background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hairline Art Deco lettering in the upper right corner, featuring a large circular 'C' and interlocking thin lines, with a smaller red sans-serif subtitle directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the main subject in black and white?
Is the display text hairline thin and geometric?
Is the cat clearly visible and held by the subject?
Is the subtitle text muted red?

adjustableVariables: Specific breed of the black cat
Hue of the red accent text
mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos
Ensure the typography is a new custom interpretation of the style
postGenerationChecks: Check that the subject's silhouette is sharp against the background
Verify the typography does not overlap the subject's head
Ensure the red text is the only significant color in the image
Confirm the cat is positioned as a focal point near the face
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High Contrast Monochrome + Animal Companion + Art Deco Hairline Typography
